meta.title: INDIAN FOOD IN NINH BINH | VIETNAM PART 2 #ninhbinh #vietnamvlog #vietnamtravel #vietnam #danang
meta.description:
So guys, this is a beautiful place, my first destination NINH BINH in North Vietnam. Met this gentleman, Mr.Raj Chauhan who owns a restaurant (CURRY KING) & offers amazing Indian food. A very cute and cozy restaurant in the heart of Ninh binh. If you are visiting this place you must try the food here. It was awesome and yes, tea lovers don't have to worry. You get the finest Masala chai here. I have tried to convey all the information in this video, if you still have any questions don't hesitate to ask me in the comment section. I am here to help in every possible way.
Moving on to our second destination & the name of the place is DANANG, South Vietnam. Unfortunately I do not have any video of this place but i am mentioning the name of the other Indian restaurant which i discovered. The name is FAMILY INDIAN RESTAURANT. Food was delicious i must say. If you are in Danang, do check this place out. 
I hope you like this video, if you do please do not forget to like. share & subscribe. You stay well and strong & il see you again soon with some interesting videos. 😍😍😘
